description_en: Call DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeDetailData to batch query traffic and request data for accelerated domain names at a 1-minute granularity. The data is aggregated by region and carrier. The maximum time range for a single query is 10 minutes
description_zh: 调用DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeDetailData批量获取域名的各地区运营商流量和访问次数的1分钟粒度数据。该API最长查询跨度不超过10分钟
name: DescribeDcdnDomainRealTimeDetailData

parameters.help_en: The accelerated domain name. You can specify multiple domain names and separate them with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 加速域名，多个用英文逗号（,）分隔
parameters.name: domain_name

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 获取数据的起始时间点。日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en:
The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

The end time must be later than the start time. The maximum time range that can be queried is 10 minutes
parameters.help_zh:
获取数据的结束时间点，日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。

结束时间需大于起始时间，且查询跨度不得超过10分钟
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The information to query. You can specify multiple values and separate them with commas (,). Valid values:

qps: queries per second (QPS).

bps: bandwidth.

http_code: HTTP status codes
parameters.help_zh:
获取的类别信息，多个用逗号（,）分隔。取值：

qps：每秒访问次数。
bps：带宽数据。
http_code：HTTP返回码
parameters.name: field

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the region. You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query regions.

If you do not set this parameter, data in all regions is queried
parameters.help_zh:
地域英文名，通过[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)获得。

默认查询所有地域
parameters.name: location_name_en

parameters.help_en:
The English name of the internet service provider (ISP). You can call the [DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~) operation to query ISPs.

If you do not set this parameter, data from all ISPs is queried
parameters.help_zh:
运营商英文名，通过[DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp](~~DescribeDcdnRegionAndIsp~~)获得。

默认查询所有运营商
parameters.name: isp_name_en

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to return aggregated data. Valid values:

true

false

The default value is false
parameters.help_zh:
是否输出汇总值。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

默认值为false
parameters.name: merge

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to aggregate data by region and ISP. Valid values:

true

false

The default value is false
parameters.help_zh:
是否合并LocationNameEn和IspNameEn输出汇总值。取值：
true：是。
false：否。

默认值为false
parameters.name: merge_loc_isp

The list of data returned.

Data.description_zh:
